verdict.rationale: Postman supports designing/exporting APIs in OpenAPI-compatible Postman Collection format via Spec Hub, and the platform itself exposes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (openapi.json) confirmed by direct probe, plus a documented Postman API for programmatic access. missing for 10: no explicit doc citation showing a one-click 'export as OpenAPI' UI flow or independent hands-on confirmation of spec fidelity.
